messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Service 'chat-streaming' p99 latency spike detected in eu-west-1. p95=980ms (SLO 700ms), p99=2250ms (SLO 1200ms). Error-rate stable. Correlated rise in streaming stall counts (sessions with stalled chunks). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/streams?range=15m

jordan (oncall): ack. paging oncall. any recent changes deployed to streaming inference in eu-west-1?

lee (ml-ops): yep — we rolled out a precision profile change (int8 calibration variant) for redwood-chat-v2 yesterday 03:20 UTC to reduce token cost. It was targeted (10% -> 100% over 6h) and marked as for short-context workloads. rollout-id: rp-2026-03-14-0318.

ryan (platform): confirming the same rollout. infra-side I see a jump in dequant queue length on the serving hosts during the spike window. Also observed increased KV-cache eviction rate around exact spike times.

amy (runtime): past 10 lines from the runtime logs showing hot path latencies and stall markers:
```
[2026-03-14T04:12:07Z] model=redwood-chat-v2 variant=int8 calibrate=enabled stage=decode token_ms=4 queue_ms=1200 stall=1
[2026-03-14T04:12:08Z] model=redwood-chat-v2 variant=int8 stage=kv_fetch miss=1 lock_wait_ms=700
[2026-03-14T04:12:09Z] model=redwood-chat-v2 variant=int8 stage=dequant retry=0 dequant_ms=630
[2026-03-14T04:12:10Z] model=redwood-chat-v2 variant=fp16 stage=decode token_ms=3 queue_ms=80 stall=0
```
Looks like int8 dequant and kv-locks are amplifying tail latency for streams with long prefixes.

jordan (oncall): thanks. immediate mitigation steps: 1) divert streaming sessions >512 tokens to fp16 variant; 2) abort ongoing calibration rollouts (if any) and set int8 rollout to 0% in eu-west-1; 3) enable sticky kv-cache for sessions when possible. I'll coordinate. @deploy-bot can you run route fallback?

deploy-bot: running command `redwoodctl routing set-fallback --service chat-streaming --from-profile int8 --to-profile fp16 --condition "session.len>512" --region eu-west-1 --reason "p99 spike"`
deploy-bot: accepted. applying canary to 5% traffic now. cmd-id: cmd-9842

maya (oncall-next): are customers impacted? how many sessions timed out vs degraded?

omar (cs): quick check — we have 3 customers flagged via support tickets (Searchly, NoteWave, ScribeAI) reporting partial stream stalls/timeouts for some users in EU. Searchly has some timeouts for long transcripts. raising customer-impact high.

lee (ml-ops): fwiw calibration job logs show a subset of layers with large quantization scale drift for long-context tokens. I suspect the int8 calibration used samples that underrepresented long prefixes. Reverting rollout or using a conservative int8 profile for streaming long-context is safer.

amy (runtime): recommendation: 1) revert int8 rollout in eu-west-1 immediately; 2) set routing preference so new streaming sessions >512 tokens go to fp16-stream variant; 3) for live sessions, enable fallback-on-stall to re-request next tokens from fp16 variant (graceful handoff). I can push the fallback switch but need approval.

jordan (oncall): do it. prioritize customer availability over cost.

deploy-bot: executing `redwoodctl rollout abort --rollout-id rp-2026-03-14-0318 --region eu-west-1`
deploy-bot: abort confirmed. setting rollout to 0%.

deploy-bot: updating routing canary to 20% -> 50% -> 100% as healthy metrics observed.

ryan (platform): applied sticky kv-cache policy for sessions routed to fp16-stream. Also bumped max concurrent dequant worker threads temporarily to reduce queue latency.

(6m later) incidents-bot: updated metrics snapshot — after routing changes p95=650ms, p99=900ms, stall-rate down 84% from peak. Some long-context sessions still show intermittent stalls.

amy (runtime): log fragment after mitigations:
```
[2026-03-14T04:20:11Z] model=redwood-chat-v2 variant=fp16 stage=decode token_ms=4 queue_ms=35 stall=0
[2026-03-14T04:20:12Z] model=redwood-chat-v2 variant=int8 stage=decode token_ms=5 queue_ms=600 stall=1
```
Shows traffic still hitting int8 for some edge sessions (sticky routing timing). We should force-complete rollback and block any int8 assignment for streaming sessions for 48h.

jordan (oncall): agreed. lee, please open a follow-up to re-run calibration with long-context traces and conservative quant thresholds. tag: ml/quant.

lee (ml-ops): opened issue QNT-3421: "recalibrate int8 for streaming long-context; add layer-level error telemetry; gate by sample-coverage." Also adding synthetic stress tests for prefix lengths >1024.

omar (cs): drafting customer note for impacted accounts. snippet: "We observed increased tail latency for long streaming sessions in EU yesterday due to a model precision profile change. We reverted the change and routing has been updated; service is stable. We're running a deeper postmortem and will follow up with remediation plan." approve?

sasha (product): fine to send the note after we confirm no regressions for 2 hours. include a short timeline and mitigation steps.

jordan (oncall): handing off to maya for night-watch. maya — you'll own the watch and the postmortem doc. flag any regressions or new customer reports to pagers. Handoff command: `oncall-handoff --to maya --incident 1745559876 --summary "precision-profile induced spike, rollback applied"`.

maya (oncall-next): ack. I'll monitor p99 & stall-rate, and keep cs/product looped. I'll also coordinate with lee tomorrow for the calibration plan.

jordan (oncall): one more TODO: add an automatic gating rule to our rollout pipeline: block precision-profile rollouts if 95th token-latency for samples >512 increases by >20% in the first 30 minutes. filing RNF-guard.

incidents-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. SLOs returning to normal. Incident owner: jordan (oncall). follow-up: QNT-3421 (ml), PB-1180 (runbook update), CS-205 (customer comms).

omar (cs): customer note sent to Searchly + NoteWave + ScribeAI. they acknowledged and will reopen if they see issues.

jordan (oncall): closing paging for now. will kick off 1-hour postmortem sync in #incidents-postmortem. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maya (oncall-next): taking watch. ping me if p99 > 1200ms or stall-rate > 5% in eu-west-1.

deploy-bot: incident ticket 1745559876 updated: status=monitoring, mitigations_applied=[rollback, routing-fallback, kv-cache-sticky]. logs archived.
